title: GlossBERT: BERT for Word Sense Disambiguation with Gloss Knowledge
answer_rationale: The documents indicate that WordNet glosses are used to construct context-gloss pairs for input into the BERT model, and multiple methods (e.g., GlossBERT) leverage WordNet sense glosses to perform Word Sense Disambiguation. This demonstrates incorporation of WordNet into the model.
